findings.passage: Montana's existing voter ID law and the state's constitutional authority to run its own elections.
findings.note: Issue item 'Protect voting rights and election security' on his campaign site, listed under 'Seth supports'. The date is the page's last-updated stamp for this item. It names the state's current voter ID law and state authority over elections. It gives no detail on what ID counts or what happens to a voter without ID.

findings.passage: Seth will oppose federal mandates that strip states of that authority, from either party.
findings.note: Same campaign-site item. It says he would oppose federal mandates on how states run elections. It does not name the SAVE Act or any bill.
